title: Apollo 11 missing tapes - Wikipedia
snippet: Wikipedia account of the lost Apollo 11 SSTV telemetry tapes.
quote: The researchers concluded that the tapes containing the raw unprocessed Apollo 11 SSTV signal were erased and reused by NASA in the early 1980s, following standard procedure at the time.
stance_why: Documents the permanent destruction of the raw primary record, supporting the skeptic's chain-of-custody ceiling argument.

title: Moon Rock Turns Out to be Fake - Phys.org
snippet: 2009 Phys.org report on the Rijksmuseum's fake moon rock.
quote: The Dutch national Rijksmuseum made an embarrassing announcement last week that one of its most loved possessions, a moon rock, is a fake -- just an old piece of petrified wood that's never been anywhere near the moon.
stance_why: Documents the Apollo apparatus passing off a fake lunar artifact, supporting the skeptic's point that the program's machinery is not above fabrication.
